This '''Neimoidian''' [[Gender/Legends|female]] was a historic figure in [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] society.

==Biography==
She was significant enough to be granted a portrait, which displayed her in regal clothing posed in front of a hanging drapery. This artwork came to hang in a gallery within [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod's]] [[Lott Dod's palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].

==Behind the scenes==
This motif "[https://pp.userapi.com/c639728/v639728209/1edc0/dtY-47RlPsk.jpg Russian Empress Catherine the Great]".
